gates.name: display font is not Inter/Roboto/Open Sans/Poppins/Lato/system
no purple-blue / cyan-magenta gradient
no gradient text (background-clip: text)
no thick side-stripe borders (border-left/right ≥ 3px, inset side box-shadow)
no pure #fff / #000 as a colour
no transition: all (or property-less transition)
no bouncy overshoot easing
one hover signal per element (not transform + shadow together)
no animated width/height/top/left/margin/padding
focus ring appears instantly (not transitioned)
Hallmark stamp at the top of the stylesheet
spacing on the named 4-pt scale
interactive states present (focus-visible, active, disabled)
every motion has a prefers-reduced-motion fallback
one icon voice (no Unicode glyphs standing in for icons)
decorative svg/canvas has aria-hidden or a name
no horizontal scroll at 390 or 1440
at most three type families (display, body, one outlier)
input focus uses outline, not a border/box-shadow change
body text ≥ 4.5:1 on its surface
focus ring ≥ 3:1 against the page
accent fill has a named text token (accent-ink)
no centred-everything blocks (empty states, help boxes)
no colour/font improvisation outside tokens.css
no clickable label wraps to two lines
image-bearing 1fr grid tracks use minmax(0, 1fr)
html and body overflow-x: clip
display heads break long words (overflow-wrap: anywhere)
tap targets ≥ 44 px (all screens, both viewports)
every icon/unnamed button has a name
the screen's next step is visible without scrolling
the logo has alt text
